note: Sound cue IDs used by the game. 'prompt' is what scripts/generate-audio.mjs sends to ElevenLabs: Sound Effects for most cues, Music (engine: music) for the four music loops; 'duration' is in seconds. Volumes are suggested mix levels (gain in dB relative to full scale). Every cue has a visual twin in the UI, so the game works muted.
